timeline.description: Construction of supercell models (pure, disordered, vacancy-containing) followed by ab initio equilibrium and nonequilibrium molecular dynamics simulations at multiple temperatures (300–1000 K) to evaluate Li-ion diffusion.

_llm_flag.reasoning: The paper explicitly describes (i) construction of supercell models and defective/disordered/vacancy-containing variants based on Li6PS5Cl (2× unit-cell supercell, 104 atoms) and Li5PS4Cl2 derived by S2→Cl substitution plus Li removal for charge balance; (ii) use of both equilibrium (EMD) and nonequilibrium (NEMD, color diffusion) ab initio molecular dynamics simulations; and (iii) simulations at multiple temperatures spanning 300–1000 K for Li5PS4Cl2 (300, 600, 800, 1000 K) to evaluate Li-ion diffusion (self-diffusion coefficient/ionic conductivity).
